title: Work IQ: REST endpoint tools for agents
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts and documented background controls are supported, and no source checked explicitly identifies the planned REST endpoint tools with an existing integration. Minor corrections should reflect Work IQ's published consumption licensing and complete the registry navigation paths.
